description: Search adopted texts, committee documents, plenary documents, or MEP declarations on awareness of conflicts of interest (source mep_declarations); mode get with document_id returns any work's metadata and source-file links, not extracted text. Get takes document IDs from every tool, whatever the family; parent_document_ids lead from subdivisions to parent files, and adopted and based-on relations read with mode get, though a target can be unavailable upstream. Detail procedure_ids add the procedure an adopted text, plenary or committee document publishes on its family record; adopted and based-on relations never imply procedure links. Filters: text and sitting dates serve adopted_texts; title and related_process_id serve adopted_texts and mep_declarations; person_id and awareness_of_conflict serve mep_declarations; committee takes term but no year, plenary year but no term. euparl_list_reference topic document_types lists work_type codes. Adopted-text rows carry title, date and procedure_ids; declaration rows add what was declared, capacities and version links; committee and plenary rows carry identity only, so their title and date need mode get. Non-keyword adopted texts sort by document_id; keyword searches keep relevance order, and declaration searches past 100 matches read aligned 100-row pages; either can repeat or omit records across pages. Adopted texts and declarations reach the first 10000 results; continue with page.next_offset when present, otherwise narrow the filters.

awareness_of_conflict.description: mep_declarations only: true keeps declarations of awareness of a conflict of interest, false those declaring none.

document_id.description: Get only: a work ID from any tool, any family: canonical ID (TA-9-2024-0138), eli/dl/doc/ prefix or public URI in any case, or a returned citation (label, public_register_ref or decision label): T9-0138/2024, P9_TA(2024)0138, A9-0188/2023, P9_A(2023)0188, B9-0163/2024 (read as B-, else the QOB- question motion), RC-B9-0163/2024 or P9_OJQ(2024)03-13. Question citations belong to euparl_list_questions.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Caps: 1000 documents, 100 adopted texts, 100 keyword adopted texts, or 100 MEP declarations; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

mode.description: Default search; get requires document_id and takes no source or search filter.

person_id.description: mep_declarations only: declarant person ID (124867), person/ prefix or public person URI; never with term.

related_process_id.description: Procedure reference YYYY-NNNN, YYYY/NNNN(TYPE), prefix or public URI; adopted_texts and mep_declarations search.

sitting_date.description: adopted_texts only: sitting date YYYY-MM-DD, or range start with sitting_date_end.

sitting_date_end.description: adopted_texts only: inclusive range end YYYY-MM-DD; needs sitting_date and not before it.

source.description: Search only; default adopted_texts. mep_declarations lists MEP declarations on awareness of conflicts of interest.

term.description: Term 0–10; adopted_texts, committee and mep_declarations search, never with person_id.

text.description: adopted_texts only: keyword search in the requested language.

title.description: adopted_texts and mep_declarations only: title search in the requested language. A declaration title names the member, capacity, committee and procedure.

work_type.description: Search only: family-specific code from euparl_list_reference topic document_types, any case.

year.description: Document year; adopted_texts, plenary and mep_declarations search.

name: euparl_search_documents

available.description: Whether the source array was published; a published empty array counts.

adopted_document_ids.description: Adopted document relations in published order; mode get reads them, though a target can be unavailable upstream.

awareness_of_conflict.description: Declaration detail only, from the declaration record: whether the member declared awareness of a conflict of interest.

based_on_document_ids.description: Based-on document relations in published order; no procedure link is inferred.

capacities.description: Declaration detail only, from the declaration record (a notice says when that read failed): one capacity per published participation, in published order; absent when none.

items.description: One declared capacity; each field only when published.

organization_id.description: Published committee or body, verbatim, such as org/LIBE.

person_ids.description: Declarant person IDs, in published order.

political_group_id.description: Published political group in this capacity, verbatim.

role.description: Published role code, verbatim, such as def/ep-roles/RAPPORTEUR.

conflict_description.description: Declaration detail only, from the declaration record: the member's published description of the conflict, verbatim in the language filed; absent when none.

creator_ids.description: All published creator references, without inferred authorship.

links.description: Every source-file link in the selected language, with its metadata.

issued.description: Published issue date; absent when issued_values lists several.

issued_values.description: Every issue date of this language and format when several, in published order; none names a file, so every link of the format carries the list.

size_bytes.description: Published byte size, a decimal string; absent when size_bytes_values lists several.

size_bytes_values.description: Every byte size of this language and format when several, decimal strings in published order; none names a file, so every link of the format carries the list.

items.description: Published byte size, a decimal string.

parent_document_ids.description: Parent documents; read with mode get when a subdivision lacks files.

previous_version_ids.description: Declaration detail only, from the declaration record: declarations this one replaces; absent when unpublished; read with mode get.

procedure_ids.description: Procedures from explicit relations, then those an adopted text, plenary or committee document publishes on its family record, without repeats; use euparl_get_procedure.

superseded_by_ids.description: Declaration detail only, from the declaration record: declarations replacing this one; absent when unpublished; read with mode get.

value.description: Published title; the first of several.

values.description: Every title in this language, in published order; only when there are several.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A code, identifier, language, date range or source filter is unsupported, term is combined with person_id, or an adopted-text or declaration offset reaches the 10000-result search window. `invalid_mode_fields`: Get lacks document_id, mixes search filters or pages; search supplies document_id. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects the validated request. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limiting outlasts the retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Get only: false when the record is missing or empty.

items.description: Search page; absent in get mode.

awareness_of_conflict.description: Declaration rows only: whether the member declared awareness of a conflict of interest.

capacities.description: Declaration rows only: one capacity per published participation, in published order; absent when none.

items.description: One declared capacity; each field only when published.

organization_id.description: Published committee or body, verbatim, such as org/LIBE.

person_ids.description: Declarant person IDs, in published order.

political_group_id.description: Published political group in this capacity, verbatim.

role.description: Published role code, verbatim, such as def/ep-roles/RAPPORTEUR.

conflict_description.description: Declaration rows only: the member's published description of the conflict, verbatim in the language filed; absent when none.

date.description: Adopted-text and declaration rows only: published date.

previous_version_ids.description: Declaration rows only: declarations this one replaces; absent when unpublished; read with mode get.

procedure_ids.description: Adopted-text and declaration rows only: procedures named by an adopted text's family relation (sitting events left out) or a declaration's refers-to relation, in published order, as detail reads them; use euparl_get_procedure.

superseded_by_ids.description: Declaration rows only: declarations replacing this one; absent when unpublished; read with mode get.

title.description: Adopted-text and declaration rows only: title in the requested language, the only one a list returns; absent when the row has none (the notice counts them; mode get reads other languages).

value.description: Published title; the first of several.

values.description: Every title in this language, in published order; only when there are several.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

page.description: Search page position; absent in get mode.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist or cannot be ruled out.

limit.description: Effective page size after caps and the search window.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; absent at the search-window boundary even when has_more is true.

snapshot.description: Pass back with next_offset to continue this local collection.

totalCount.description: Exact total; only when published or counted over the whole collection.

truncated.description: True when this page holds only part of the collection.
